# Gladia

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: developer-audio-AI product and marketing design: a declared :root token layer of --color-neutral-0..1000 and --color-purple/blue/green/red/yellow/orange/pink ramps (brand purple #947afc) behind a dark-by-default glass surface (black --bg-primary, rgba glass nav, hairline translucent borders, purple #925bff brand CTAs), a 4px --space-* scale, --radius-* pill geometry, --font-size-10..80 ramp in 'Suisse Intl' with 'Geist Mono' code, --duration-*/--ease-* motion, and the semantic --text-*/--bg-*/--border-* roles re-pointed under body.light-mode on /library and .section--white on white sections; a hover-intent mega-menu header, an Async/Real-time pricing grid with a calculator, a demo-request form, a Mintlify docs site with a real light/dark preference, app-shell auth cards and a 390px pass.

Captured 2026-11-16, signed out (every captured surface is public; the app console and every post-login surface - API keys, transcription playground, usage, billing - is an authenticated boundary never reached; the /demo-request, pricing-calculator, login and signup fields were measured and typed into then cleared, never submitted; every CTA, SSO button, nav item and link was measured, never followed; the mega-menu opens by hover intent or keyboard, the pricing-mode toggle and FAQ accordions are local UI toggles, and the docs dark theme is the Mintlify site's own preference). Themes: dark, light.

A token set and component reference for Gladia's public surfaces — for building developer-audio-AI marketing pages, pricing grids, docs-site chrome and the sign-in edge in the style of the real thing. It was read from **gladia.io** on **2026-11-15**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844, and the public tree plus the empty auth walls were walked again on **2026-11-21**. Captured: the home page, /pricing, the /product/speech-to-text-api family (plus /real-time and /async), /product/audio-intelligence, the /use-cases/* family (voice-agents, meeting-assistants, ccaas, media), /about-us, /blog, /changelog, /testimonials, /partners, /library, /demo-request, /security, /compliance-hub, /gladiaflow, /solaria-3, /creator-program, /start-up-studio, /meeting-assistant-market-map, /benchmark-reliability-checker and /competitors/benchmarks; the header's Product mega-menu measured and the other four captured; three docs.gladia.io pages (the Mintlify introduction, a quickstart and an API page — including the docs' own dark theme preference); the app.gladia.io / and /signup auth shells; and 390px passes on home, pricing, demo-request, library and a docs page.

Gladia is worth a capture because its marketing site declares a real token layer to the browser: `--color-neutral-0..1000` and `--color-purple/blue/green/red/yellow/orange/pink` ramps (brand purple `--color-purple` #947afc, `--color-purple-500` #925bff), `--alpha-white-*`/`--alpha-black-*` translucents, a 4px `--space-*` scale, `--radius-*` pill geometry, a `--font-size-10..80` ramp in **Suisse Intl** with **Geist Mono** for code, `--duration-*`/`--ease-*` motion and the semantic `--text-*`/`--bg-*`/`--border-*` roles. The architecture is unusual: `:root` paints **dark** on every marketing page — an emulated `prefers-color-scheme` pass resolves identically and no theme control exists — while `body.light-mode` re-points the roles to the light values /library paints, and `.section--white` re-points a smaller subset for white sections inside dark pages. docs.gladia.io is a separate Mintlify stack with a genuine light/dark preference; app.gladia.io is the product auth shell. **Boundary:** the app console and every post-login surface — API keys, the transcription playground, usage, billing — was never reached. On 2026-11-21 the sign-in, forgot-password, and sign-up walls were photographed empty: nothing was typed, and Google was not clicked. The 2026-11-15 component pass did type into demo, calculator, and auth fields and then cleared them; those filled states are not this refresh. The mega-menu opens by hover or click, the pricing toggle and FAQ accordions are local UI toggles, and the docs dark preference was opened and restored.

## Typography

No composite type styles in tokens.json; the README text below names the faces and sizes.

### Fonts (from README.md)

**Suisse Intl** (book/regular/medium/semibold) carries every heading, control and body on the marketing site; **Geist Mono** draws code, labels and the mega-menu eyebrows — both self-hosted woff2 under `/assets` and `/css`, declared by the harvest's 5 @font-face rules. The /blog Webflow stack and the Mintlify docs ship their own faces. The style guide falls back to system fonts; Suisse Intl is a commercial face — substitute a neutral grotesque, never ship the files.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **Captured with the automation flag masked.** The public capture (`tools/capture/public/`) hid `navigator.webdriver` from every page, so the committed readings and screenshots it took were taken past that mask. The scripts no longer hide it (edited, not run); a recapture that meets a bot check records it as a boundary.
- **`lib-card`, `blog-card`, `blog-h1` and `glass-card` read 0x0 or missed**: the selectors matched elements the page kept hidden, zero-sized or renamed — honest misses kept in the data, not gaps filled by hand. `glass-card` and `login-signup-link` mount nothing the selectors could settle on at all.
- **The auth shell's `login-email`/`signup-email` are 0x0** because the app keeps the email step behind the SSO screen; the password field measured 336 x 24.
- **`demo-terms`' `focused` state could not land a keyboard focus** (the real input is visually hidden behind its `label.form-checkbox`), so that reading is the label at rest — the `via` field says so.
- **Quantised screenshots** are 256-colour PNGs; read exact colours from `tokens.json`, never from a screenshot pixel.
- **The docs `dark` theme and the auth shell are different stacks**: their values live in measurements and screenshots, not in the marketing token sets — do not read `dark.*` tokens as the docs' or app's theme.
- **Calculator prices, plan amounts and marketing copy** are content, not style: only frames and components were measured, and alternate calculator outputs were never captured.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do let the dark :root carry the page.** Every marketing surface paints black `--bg-primary` with white ink ([home](screenshots/home-dark-default.png)); the `dark` token set is the default, not an opt-in.
2. **Do spend the purple on structure, not floods.** #947afc/#925bff mark eyebrow labels, focus rings, gradients and selected states ([mega-menu](components/crops/mega-panel-default.png), [pricing toggle](components/crops/price-mode-async-focus-visible.png)); the header CTA is a plain white pill — restraint is the pattern.
3. **Do use glass for chrome.** The navbar and mega-menu are rgba-black fills over hairline `alpha.white.*` borders at 20–23px radius ([nav pill](components/crops/nav-demo-default.png)); sections stack on the black field.
4. **Do pair the two voices on purpose.** Suisse Intl for everything a reader reads, Geist Mono for code, eyebrows and labels ([hero](components/crops/hero-h1-default.png), [docs code](components/crops/docs-code-default.png)).
5. **Don't style the signed-in console from this package.** The app shell was measured only at its auth edge ([login](screenshots/login-dark-default.png)); every post-login surface is unknown.
6. **Don't treat `light` as a theme toggle.** It is the `body.light-mode` scope /library paints ([library](screenshots/library-light-default.png)); no marketing page offers a switch, and the docs dark preference is a different token layer entirely.
7. **Don't fabricate form outcomes.** The 2026-11-21 walls were photographed empty and never submitted ([sign in](screenshots/login-dark-default.png)). Error, loading and success states are unverified.
8. **Don't copy the brand or the fonts.** The wordmark, icons and Suisse Intl files are Gladia's ([logo](components/crops/mkt-logo-default.png)); the tokens describe the system, not its artwork.
